title: Sources & further reading
body:
Entry rules: European Commission — Your Europe and Visa policy of Andorra. Border checks: EU Entry/Exit System (EES). Transit: Direct Bus. Sights: museus.ad (Sant Esteve, Santa Coloma) and casadelavall.ad (Casa de la Vall visits). Food: MiraKbé. Hiking: Visit Andorra — Nature & sports. Emergency services: Visit Andorra — Public services. Tax: Govern d'Andorra — e-Tràmits (IGI).

Two figures should be re-checked before travel: Caldea's current admission price and hours (caldea.com blocks automated fetches, so no specific figure is confirmed here) and the US State Department's current advisory level for Andorra (travel.state.gov blocks automated fetches — widely reported elsewhere as Level 1, but not independently confirmed).
